_about: THE SACRED LOTUS (Nelumbo nucifera): great round blue-green pads, waxy so the water beads on them, a few floating and most held high on stalks; above them big cupped pink flowers round a flat-topped seed head. Its LOOK, painted into the flowers' atlas (plants/flowers.js): petal / petal2 / centre / leaf / spike -- shape, colours (a list: one a variant), throat, veins and touches. How it GROWS -- stem, leaves, blooms and their sizes -- is its recipe in plants/flowers.js (GROW).
